<div class="b-section-head"><div><span class="b-kicker">Format</span><h2>The two tests</h2></div></div>

| Test | Date | Format | What it evaluates |
|---|---|---|---|
| **AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)** | Nov 16, 2026 | 65 questions · 90 min · pass mark 700/1000 | AI and ML, generative AI, foundation models on AWS, responsible AI, security and governance |
| **Blend360 All Star: abstract reasoning** | Dec 18, 2026 | 30 min | Figure series, matrices, dominoes, number and letter series |
| **Blend360 All Star: technical test** (in English) | Dec 18, 2026 | 90 min | SQL · Python · AWS and data analytics · algorithms · databases · data structures · problem solving |

<div class="b-section-head"><div><span class="b-kicker">Method</span><h2>The method in four steps</h2></div></div>

<ol class="b-steps">
<li class="b-step"><strong>Learn in Spanish</strong><p>Read each module with a goal: when you finish it you must be able to answer its self-assessment without looking.</p></li>
<li class="b-step"><strong>Re-read and practise in English</strong><p>Every page has an English twin (language switch at the top). Exercises are in English, like the test, with the translation hidden.</p></li>
<li class="b-step"><strong>Test yourself against the clock</strong><p>Do the exercises without opening the solution, then the timed mock exams. Log every score in <a href="progreso.en.html">My progress</a>.</p></li>
<li class="b-step"><strong>Review your mistakes, not everything</strong><p>Every miss goes to the mistake notebook with the rule you learned and a review date. That is your best study material.</p></li>
</ol>

::: {.callout-note title="Unofficial material"}
Community study material, not affiliated with Blend360 or AWS. The questions are original. What is known about Blend360's process comes from public candidate reviews: see [What Blend360 evaluates](guides/que-evalua-blend360.en.qmd).
:::
